title: Nvidia slide extends after HSBC downgrade

timeline.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns
timeline.line: CFO Colette Kress is interim CEO; the stock fell as much as 14% before trimming losses
more: Huang stepped down as president, CEO and board member with immediate effect
The exit followed a company investigation into his personal conduct
Nvidia is searching internally and externally for a permanent CEO

timeline.title: Nvidia slide extends after HSBC downgrade
timeline.line: Shares fell again on Friday after HSBC downgraded the stock, after a 4.34% drop Thursday
more: CFO Colette Kress is interim CEO after Jensen Huang's resignation
Harvey C. Jones becomes Nvidia's first independent chairman
The turmoil is clouding the AI trade across Asia
